تحتفرين (form VIII)
# تَحْتَفِرِينَ (taḥtafirīna) /taħ.ta.fi.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَفَرَ (iḥtafara)
# تُحْتَفَرِينَ (tuḥtafarīna) /tuħ.ta.fa.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَفَرَ (iḥtafara)
